newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.877 billion yuan from 2.64 billion on Monday and the most active one was the seven-day contract.

Rumours that the central bank would cut the reserve ratio prevailed on the market, traders said, after a Hong Kong newspaper reported the People's Bank of China was likely to cut the reserve ratio by three percent to 10 percent on April 1.
Expectations of a cut prevented some active buyers from trading on the market, traders said.
But a good performance by domestic A shares and a new issue on the market were positive factors driving non-bank financial centres to active trade, resulting in a rise in turnover, they said.
